items.title: `request_body::m176_a_body_read_as_a_stream_on_both_backends` is a RACE on native: its case `an unfinished stream is discarded as an unread body` expected 200 and read `413 Content Too Large` once on CI (ubuntu 1/2 at next 0b6118f9; green on 67111085, green locally and on the lane)
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-04 (the integrator's find at the Order 56 seal)
items.discussion: the case sends a second (pipelined) request after a handler read part of a stream and answered; natively the discard of the unfinished stream races the next request's head - when the discard has not finished counting the body against the cap, the next request's bytes are read as the old body's and the cap refuses them (413)
items.body: Rec: the pin waits for the server's own signal that the discard finished (the refused_body_census or a drained count) before sending the next request, or the native server defers the next head until the discard settles (the honest fix: a pipelined request after an abandoned stream must not be read as body bytes - that is a server bug if it can happen to a real client, not only a pin). Decide which by reproducing under load (`stress -c 8` while looping the binary 50 times). Sizing S.
